an4.48:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an4.48:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Visākho Pañcāliputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya aneḷagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya.
an4.48:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen' upaṭṭhānasālā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an4.48:2.1: Ko nu kho bhikkhave upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti . . . anissitāyāti?
an4.48:2.2: Āyasmā bhante Visākho Pañcāliputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samuttejesi sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya . . . anissitāyāti.
an4.48:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Visākhaṃ Pañcāliputtaṃ etad avoca
an4.48:3.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ Visākha bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . anissitāyāti. 2.
an4.48:5.4: dhammo hi isinan dhajo ti. 49. 1. Cattāro
